issues.description: The problem statement and UML refer to a method named printFarmSong(), but both the template and the solution implement and reference singFarmSong() instead. This name mismatch between the specification and the code can confuse students about which method they must implement or call (tests or instructions might expect printFarmSong while the provided code uses singFarmSong).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across specification, template, and solution. Either rename the methods in template and solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong(), and update all references (including Main and tests), or update the problem statement and UML to refer to singFarmSong() consistently.

issues.description: The UML and problem statement show a private helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal): void that takes an Animal parameter, and the solution implements singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). However, the template's singFarmSongVerse method signature has the Animal parameter commented out (no parameter). This discrepancy in the template's method signature can prevent students from matching the intended implementation and will cause compile/signature confusion when implementing the verse printing logic.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template's private singFarmSongVerse signature to accept an Animal parameter (e.g., private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) so its signature matches the UML and the solution. Ensure any calls to this helper pass the Animal instance.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML refer to a Farm method named printFarmSong(), and the task text asks to implement printFarmSong(), but both the template and the provided solution use the method name singFarmSong(). This inconsistent naming of the same conceptual method across artifacts can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the problem statement and UML to refer to singFarmSong(), or (B) rename the method in the template and solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() and update all call sites (including Main and UML) accordingly. Prefer renaming the code (template & solution) to match the problem text if tests expect printFarmSong(), or vice versa to align instructions with existing template.
